anchors.paper_title: bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset
anchors.reason: The paper 'bigP3BCI' describes the curation and release of the P300-based BCI dataset, which matches the dataset's name and authors.

metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) with 16 channels arranged in a standard 10-20 montage at a sampling rate of 256 Hz. The experimental paradigm employed a P300 speller task with a 9x8 character grid using adaptive/checkerboard stimulus presentation. Each trial had a duration of 1.0 second, with events classified as Target or NonTarget stimuli. Data were collected from 5 healthy subjects across 2 sessions per subject in a laboratory environment with online feedback provided to participants.
